book.name: Jon
book.title: JON Jiysis Minim Tep Jon Tikak

content: Jiysis Niykodiymas Nup Aŋgñirep Gak
Bi Peresiy bap Jiwda kanjsol mindyiŋgip ak; yimb nuk Niykodiymas.
Nuk kisyimken am Jiysis nup niŋiy aŋgak, “Tiysa. Chin niŋbun: tap mageprek gipan gok nak key ma gipnap; Gor nep nip yokek apiy mey, tap mageprek kun gok giyiŋg, chinup minim aŋgñiyiŋg gipan aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Yand nip niŋind yimb aspiyn; biynimb Gor gek key kisenimb aypay gok nep, nuk diy kond mindeniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, Niykodiymas aŋgak, “Yergiy biynimb tikayey yomb gipay gok, nonim koŋgiy namb okok tip ak amey, tikayey, biynimb key kisenimb ayniŋgambay?”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Nip niŋind yimb aspiyn. Biynimb ñiŋg ak sek, Gor Kawnan ak sek gek, Gor biynimb nuk mindpay gok nep, biynimb yand aŋgiy diy kond mindeniŋgamb.
Biynimb tikpay rek tikey mindpay ak pen; Gor Kawnan ak gek nep mey, Gor biynimb nuk mindeniŋgambay.
Kun ak minim kim kisenimb aŋgambiyn ak niŋiy, gos okok ma niŋnimin.
Yiŋgen ak damb niŋbim ak pen; wip okok sek, amimb okok sek ma niŋbim. Kun ak rek mey, biynimb Gor Kawnan bak ayek, kim kisenimb aypay gok aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, Niykodiymas aŋgak, “Nand aspan ar kun ak, yergiy giniŋgamb aŋgak.”
Aŋgek, Jiysis aŋgak, “Nand Yisrel biynimb lotiw tiysa yomb kiyk ak pen, ma niŋban?
Nip niŋind yimb aspiyn: chin windin key niŋiy, niŋrep giy nep nimbip aŋgñimbun ak pen; minim chinup ak ma dipim.
Yand nip man ar biy gip rek aŋgen, ma dipan ak, yergiy Gor miñmon biyoŋ gip rek aŋgen diniŋgamban?
Pen biynimb bap Gor miñmon biyoŋ ma taŋg niŋbay; Bi bap Ñinuk nep kun biyoŋ nimb mindiy owak.

Pen wosrey siyŋ timey gok, Yisrel biynimb kuyip siwey kumyakniŋ, Mosis tap siyŋ rek bap mon bak siŋbiyoŋ gayek, biynimb siyŋ kun ak niŋyak gok, kuyip suŋ ayak. Kun ak rek nep, Bi bap Ñinuk nup mon kiros bak biyoŋ ñaŋgbirik ayey,
biynimb nup gosimb niŋniŋgambay gok, perper mindeniŋgambay.
Gor biynimb mankumb biy maŋgiysek wasemb ay, Ñinuk nokom yimb ak kuyip nen aŋgiy yokek owak ak mey; biynimb nup gosimb niŋniŋgambay gok, kumiy ma kurginiŋgambay; nuk yip perper mindeniŋgambay.
Yenen: Gor Ñinuk nup yokak kun ak, biynimb gok kuyip, kor ginimuŋ aŋgiy ma yokak; yip ker dinimuŋ aŋgiy yokak.
“Biynimb an Ñinuk nup gosimb niŋbay gok, kor ma niŋniŋgambay. Pen biynimb nup gosimb ma niŋiy kirpay gok, minim yomb yimb ak mindip.

Minim yomb yimb diniŋgambay junj kun ak, kun giy mindip: Melik tep ak man ar biy wip ak pen; biynimb gok Melik kun ak ker amnun aŋgey, kuyip tep ma gip. Kiyk timey gi mindpay rek, kisyim wip okok nep niŋey tep gip.
Bi meliksek ak nup niŋey tep ma gek, timey gipun ak miseŋ niŋniŋgambay aŋgiy, nup ker ma opay.
Pen biynimb yipund gip ar ak gipay gok, Gor aŋgip rek gispun ak, miseŋ niŋep rek ayaŋ aŋgiy, Melik mindip kiñiŋ siŋak opay aŋgak.”
Jon Nuk Jiysis Bi Yerip Rek Ak Aŋgiy Minim Aŋgak
Kisen Jiysis, binuk gok yip am Jiwdiya propens namb okok mindiy, biynimb gok kuyip ñiŋg pikñiyiŋgipay.
Pen ñin namb kun siŋak, Jon bi ñiŋg pikñemb ak kunep, miñmon Yinon yep miñmon Salyim ñiŋg kuŋay mindek siŋak mindiy; biynimb gok wiyakniŋ, kuyip ñiŋg pikñiyiŋgip.
Jon nind kun giyiŋgip; kisen mey nup kalambis ayak.
Pen Jiwda bi bap apiy, Jiwda miñ ar kiyk ñiŋg pikyiŋgipay minim ar ak aŋgiy, Jon binuk gunap yip penpen aŋgyak.
Penpen aŋgiy, Jon binuk gok apiy nup aŋgyak, “Tiysa. Bi siŋok Joden ñiŋg gol kind bindoŋ mindek, nup biyomb aŋgenak ak, miñiy ap ñiŋg pikñakniŋ, biynimb maŋgiysek nup ker amjipay aŋgyak.”
Kun aŋgeyak, Jon aŋgak, “Gor gos nuk key niŋimb rek, chinup woŋg ar keykey aŋgayip.
Nimb key niŋbim; nimbip aŋgnik, ‘Yand Kiyŋ yomb key yimb ak mer; yikop kinjeŋ nup ak, Gor aŋgek pindsipiyn aŋgnik.’

Bi gok biyn dipay ñin ak, buŋgiy kiyk yimb gok, ‘Biyn kun ak chin rek ma dipun aŋgiy’ gos ak ma niŋbay. ‘Buŋgiy chin ak, biyn nuk ak pisnep dip aŋgiy,’ miñmiñ yimb gipay. Yand mey kun ak rek. Nuk biynimb gok kuyip kun giy disap ak, yip tep gip.
Yimb nup aranakniŋ, yimb yip apyowniŋgamb ak, tep yimb.

“Bi semb biyoŋ nimb wip ak, Biyomb yimb. Biynimb man ar biy nimb gok, semb biyoŋ nimb apiy rek, minim yipul yimb nuk niŋiy aŋgip rek aŋgniŋgiy. Kiyk lum ar biy nimb ak mey; lum ar biy minim ak aŋgniŋgambay.
Nuk Nop yip mindiy wak rek, minim yipul yimb ak aŋgip ak pen; minim nup ak ma dipay.
Pen biynimb minim nup dipay gok, Gor minim ak niŋind nep aŋgip aŋgiy dipay.
Gor bi yokak kun ak nup, Kawnan nuk ak yokek ap yip nep mindip ak mey; minim aŋgñimb ak, Gor minim yipund giy ak aŋgñimb.
Nop Ñinuk nup wasemb ay, tap okok maŋgiysek kond mindonimuŋ aŋgiy, di ñin ar nup ak ayip.
Biynimb an Ñinuk nup gosimb niŋniŋgambay gok gek, perper mindeniŋgambay; pen biynimb nup kirginiŋgambay gok kuyip gek, miker diyiŋg nep mindeniŋgambay aŋgak.”
